name: unchanged-evidence
purpose: The retained evidence of every scenario verifies before any mutation.

name: wrong-version
purpose: A held root that reports leaf_b version 0 after the edit violates the per-call selection that the profile declares.

name: stale-evidence
purpose: A changed raw stream with its old digest is stale evidence.

name: premature-retirement
purpose: A saved closure whose retained code traps after later edits violates the code-only-grows profile.

name: event-binding
purpose: A changed edit digest invalidates the prior comparison.

name: profile
purpose: A changed Relax profile invalidates the prior comparison.
